facility_prologue.name: The Morning Collection
facility_prologue.description: Standard reclamation procedure for D-Class subjects within the modern residential sector.

actions.text: The silence of the corridor is broken by the faint, rhythmic hiss of hydraulic boots. A calm, synthesized voice echoes through the dormitory speakers: 'Inmate D-902, please prepare for scheduled biometric verification.'

events.message: The seamless white blast door slides open with a whisper. Two Security Enforcers in high-gloss tactical white armor enter. One takes a position at the front, the other stands directly behind you, boxing you in. 'D-902, step into the spotlight. You are required at Testing Sector 4. Non-compliance will result in immediate neurological damping.'

options.text: Stand up and follow the enforcers into the corridor.
options.log: D-902 complied. Proceeding to Testing Sector 4 under guard escort.

options.text: Refuse to move, eyeing the gaps in their white armor.
options.log: D-902 resisted. Compliance enforced via non-lethal shock baton. Subject is being dragged to Sector 4.

actions.text: You are marched through a series of blindingly white corridors. The Lead Enforcer's footsteps echo with metallic precision. You pass several staff members who avert their eyes as you walk by.

The air grows colder as you descend a high-speed elevator. The sign on the wall now reads: SECTOR B - LIGHT CONTAINMENT. The hum of specialized equipment becomes a constant, low-frequency vibration in your teeth.

The enforcers stop before a massive, reinforced alloy door. A holographic display pulses: 'CONTAINMENT UNIT 173 - AUTHORIZED ACCESS ONLY'. The Lead Enforcer swipes a Level 4 card. The door hisses open, revealing a stark, brightly lit chamber.

events.message: You are pushed inside. The door slams shut behind you, cutting off the guards. You are now inside the containment unit. A voice crackles over the intercom: 'D-902, please approach the center of the chamber and maintain eye contact with the subject.'

options.text: Comply and step toward the center of the room.
options.log: D-902 entered the containment chamber and approached the subject as instructed.

options.text: Stay pressed against the door, refusing to move further.
options.log: D-902 showed significant fear, refusing to approach the subject.

actions.text: The overhead lights flicker violently. The hum of the facility's power core pitch-shifts into a low, ominous groan. 'Main power failing... backup generators... [REDACTED]'.

events.message: Total darkness. Then, the backup red emergency lights pulse. A roar echoes from the end of the hall. Your escorting guards freeze, looking at each other in terror. This is your chance.

options.text: Bolt into the darkness of a side hallway.

actions.text: You vanished into the shadows before the guards could react.

options.log: D-902 escaped into the maintenance shafts during the initial blackout.

options.text: Lunge for a panicked guard's sidearm.
options.log: D-902 attempted to disarm security. A struggle ensued.
